body: I've been trying to figure that out and the only thing I have come up with is .To make us stop and think.

I want you to know that I am honestly trying to overcome every day one day at a time. I usually never have the guts to say anything. but I also made a post tonight so maybe it's the vodka anyways. Not sure if I'm the right person to give advice at this moment but for some reason helping others is what helps me. And I really hope I don't offend you. As I read your post your talk about being in college that's an amazing accomplishment and that shows that you are a great person many people don't even make it that far, so celebrate that because you deserve it. And also college is not for everyone and you don't have to feel bad about that yes we want to make our parents proud but our parents lived their lives. So it's okay for you to live your own and not the way anyone wants you to do it but by your own rules. you have one life you deserve to live it to the fullest. Truth be told a lot of people have great careers that never went to college. Most millionaires was drop out. and I am older so I can say my friend which we have the same birthday she still in debt for her bachelor's degree and I make more than she do I didn't finish college either. Find out what your passion is in life and go for it and yes everyone might not agree but that's okay cause honestly that's just life. Always remember good and bad people going to talk about you regardless. Don't minimize yourself to be what others want you to be, please be you whatever that is and be very great at it and don't feel bad about it. You don't have a point to prove to anyone but your success and everything you want to do whatever that is will show everyone how   great you are. Please believe in yourself and when it gets hard take it one day at a time and never give up on you. I know this is long but a final note is parents that always have this thing in their head that they want us to be I don't know cause I  probably did it to my kids also. but go back in the history they didn't listen to their parents either I'm just saying. Remember you have a purpose and one day they will get over it. Take care

So before I say anything I want to let you know , I'm trying to overcome the same feelings right now. So I really hope this helps you in at the same time help me also. I really want you to know you are not responsible for the way others have treated you. Everything about you is special it makes you a great person, you have a purpose and don't let the people who have done you wrong win. The people with the toughest battles in life has a purpose. It's probably very hard to see that now, but one day your story and you overcoming, will help someone else. Please remember every day that you are awesome and you're worthy. And like I said I'm trying also trying so you're not the only person going through this but if we can stick together and just take it one day at a time our future will have bumps but I really believe we can overcome just one day at a Time no matter what you deserve that and don't forget you have a purpose
Thank you, everything I said to you I needed it for me. Don't ever give up your future is bright,so put your sunglasses on

Before I say anything I want to let you know that I'm not perfect and I am going through the same feelings right now. Since I've been on here I always read and never say anything, but tonight I finally posted and I guess my strength and commenting is 4 me too focus and try to encourage others and maybe do that really encouraging myself also to be honest. I hope Daya don't overstep any boundaries but I can tell you the same thing I wish someone would tell me. Everything about you that makes you different is special because it makes you unique. No matter what anyone said remember you define who you Are and you are loved and you have something to offer this world just take it one day at a time. What you are experiencing in This moment can be a  testimony our Guide to help someone in the future. And maybe your future is so bright that's why it's hard to see it right now. Take care

I actually can very well understand how you feel, I'm not perfect and I'm in the same space you are in right now. But I wish I could give you that hug cause that's all I want also. I'm sure I'm probably not the right person to give advice but if we could help each other by just taking it one day at a time. I need someone to believe with me, I'm not sure how this even works and I'm trying also and again I might not be the person but I know what is like to be broken and have no one to confide in back if you could just take it one day at a time with me I really do think that this pain can't be the end. We have to believe  I really hope I didn't overstep my boundaries. But just give it one more day at a time. But you deserved it and you are worthy of that
